TRUNCATE TABLE [DW].[RefRowLevelSecurityFilter]

DECLARE @UserEmail varchar(80)
DECLARE @BankSk int
DECLARE @BankCode [varchar](20)
DECLARE @SourceSystemCode varchar(50)
DECLARE @counter int = 1
DECLARE @recordCount int = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurity )

-- Loop through records in RefRowLevelSecurity

WHILE @counter <= @recordCount 
BEGIN  

		SELECT @UserEmail = UserEmail, @BankCode = BankID, @SourceSystemCode =  SourceSystemCode 
		FROM (SELECT A.UserEmail, A.BankID, A.SourceSystemCode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.UserEmail) AS RN FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurity A  ) as T
		WHERE T.RN = @counter



		INSERT INTO DW.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter (UserEmail, BankSk, BankID, SourceSystemCode)
		
		SELECT @UserEmail, D.BankSK,  D.BankID, A.SourceSystemCode
		---- WorkFlowId, TaskRunId
		FROM DW.DimBank D 
		CROSS APPLY   
			(SELECT SourceSystemCode FROM [DW].RefSourceSystem) A
		WHERE D.BankID = CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(@BankCode)) = 'ALL' THEN D.BankID ELSE  @BankCode END
        AND A.SourceSystemCode = CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(@SourceSystemCode)) = 'ALL' THEN A.SourceSystemCode ELSE  @SourceSystemCode END
		
		EXCEPT
		SELECT UserEmail, BankSk, BankID, SourceSystemCode  FROM [DW].[RefRowLevelSecurityFilter]

		SET @counter = @counter + 1
END
